main_text.l: Beata Eulalia, vngulas flammásque perpessa, demum
cruci affixa martyrij coronam accepit. Sed &
in Corsica, sancta Julia virgo crucis supplicio
coronata est. Plura in Martyrum historijs
Transitio ad Modum figendi praemissum de atrocitate
huius supplicij, quod Summum & Extremum dictum.
solùm, sed paene oculis subijciam saeuitiam & foeditatem
ejus supplicij: quae sane magna. Nec

page.notes: The Greek line is partly illegible and is transcribed as best read. The end of the text is cut off at the foot of the page. The marginal notes "Idem xxii Maij." and "In cap. xix. Ioan." are approximate. Page is otherwise clear.
